source: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (transparency.entsoe.eu), data items on the free re-use list, CC BY 4.0; derived values computed by the forecasting engine
method: load_da: quantiles of the day-ahead forecast daily peak (local day, max of hourly means) per ISO week +-2 weeks and day type (wd = working day, we = weekend / national holiday); flow_ref: 99.5th percentile of the hourly physical flow, last 365 days
